summary_ja: EuroHPC JUは2025年12月時点で、5年間に145百万node-hour超を配分し約2,334課題を実行、12 supercomputerを調達したと報告しています。分散systemを2026年半ばまでにfederated platformで接続する予定としますが、これは目標時期であり、統一job投入・data移動・accounting・SLAの稼働実績ではありません。19 AI Factoryと13 antennaはSME・startupへ数日で無償accessと支援を提供するとしています。HPCIでは設置台数と連合serviceの実効性を別指標で比較できます。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: EuroHPC JU reported in December 2025 that it had allocated more than 145 million node hours to about 2,334 projects over five years and procured twelve supercomputers. It planned to interconnect distributed systems through a federated platform by mid-2026, but this is a target date rather than evidence of working unified submission, data movement, accounting, or SLAs. Nineteen AI Factories and thirteen antennas were described as providing SMEs and startups with free access within days plus support. HPCI can distinguish installed-system count from effective federation services. Consensus is incomplete.

sections.title_en: EuroHPC allocation scale and federated-platform target
sections.summary_ja: 累積利用実績、設置資源、連合機能、申請時間、支援を別のservice指標にします。

items.name_ja: 145百万node-hour超・約2,334課題の累積配分
items.name_en: More than 145 million node hours and about 2,334 projects
items.statement_ja: EuroHPC JUは自律運営開始後5年間に12 supercomputerを調達し、145百万node-hour超を約2,334課題へ配分したと報告しています。この値はarchitecture、node定義、GPU/CPU内訳、利用率、待ち時間、成果数で正規化されていないため、HPCIのnode-hourや必要capacityと直接比較できません。
items.statement_en: EuroHPC JU reports procuring twelve supercomputers and allocating more than 145 million node hours to about 2,334 projects over five years of autonomous operation. The figures are not normalized by architecture, node definition, CPU/GPU composition, utilization, wait time, or outputs, so they cannot be compared directly with HPCI node hours or required capacity.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 連合基盤の規模評価には、system台数だけでなく利用者、課題、配分、消費、待ち時間、成果、支援工数を共通単位で収集する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Federation scale should be evaluated using common units for users, projects, allocations, consumption, waits, outputs, and support effort, not system count alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: CPU/GPU、node定義、precision、期間を揃えてcapacityを正規化する。
同一projectの複数system利用と重複計上を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Normalize capacity by CPU/GPU, node definition, precision, and period.
Separate awards, consumption, unused allocation, queue waits, failures, and outputs.
Check multi-system use and duplicate counting within projects.

items.name_ja: 2026年半ばの連合接続は目標、service実績は未確認
items.name_en: Mid-2026 federation is a target; service evidence remains unverified
items.timing_ja: 2026年半ばまでの目標として2025年12月に公表
items.timing_en: Published in December 2025 as a target for mid-2026
items.statement_ja: 分散配置されたEuroHPC systemは2026年半ばまでにfederated platformで接続する予定とされ、hyperconnectivity強化も進行中です。19 AI Factoryと13 antennaはSME・startupへ数日で無償accessと個別支援を提供すると説明されます。公開文は、統一identity、resource discovery、cross-site reservation、job移送、data policy、accounting、failure semanticsの完成を示しません。
items.statement_en: Distributed EuroHPC systems were planned for connection through a federated platform by mid-2026, with hyperconnectivity work in progress. Nineteen AI Factories and thirteen antennas were described as giving SMEs and startups free access within days plus tailored support. The source does not establish completed unified identity, resource discovery, cross-site reservation, job migration, data policy, accounting, or failure semantics.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIの連合運用ではportal公開を完成とせず、利用申請から結果回収までのcross-site journeyと運用責任を検収する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI federation should not equate a portal launch with completion; acceptance must cover the cross-site journey from application through result retrieval and operational responsibility.
adoption_conditions_ja: 申請から利用開始、job完了、data返却までをsite横断で測る。
target日後のproduction evidence、SLA、incident、利用実績を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Track identity, catalog, allocation, reservation, data, accounting, and support separately.
Measure cross-site time from application to access, job completion, and data return.
Verify production evidence, SLAs, incidents, and use after the target date.
